purpose: Provide a citizen-facing drill-down from an approved property timeline event to the supporting record, extracted fact, applicable law, legal effect and explicit limits.
core_principle: EVENT → RECORD → EXTRACTED FACT → LAW → LEGAL EFFECT → LIMITATION
rules: The event view explains an approved timeline event and does not create a new event.
The record identity is shown separately from the fact extracted from it.
Property and date matching are shown when material.
The exact scope of the record is preserved.
Legal effect is shown only where supported by the applicable legal authority and evidence.
Event date, document date, registration date and legal-effect date remain distinct.
A document's existence is not presented as proof of its legal effect.
A user-supplied document remains clearly labelled unless independently validated.
Restricted records are described only at the permitted access level.
hard_stops: Never claim a record establishes more than its scope supports.
Never treat a deed or contract as registration proof where registration evidence is required.
Never treat a memorial or search as the complete underlying deed.
Never add a new legal conclusion during display rendering.
